_doc: One row per event kind, read by the picture (motion-blur floors), the studio (sound placement) and QA (sync). An event's time is the first moment it shows on screen; the studio snaps it to the first frame at or after that time. lead: seconds the sound starts BEFORE that frame (most sounds: 0). span: the event has an end time t1 and its sound lasts that long. prio: 1 always plays, 3 may drop out under the voice. kFloor: minimum motion-blur sub-frames while it happens (null: no floor). after: the event grows from nothing (a fade or pop-in starts at zero), so it first shows on the frame AFTER its time, not on it.
